completionDefinition: Template content uses Chinese user-facing titles, summaries, scenarios, tools, products, step instructions, common mistakes, correction tips, safety notes, and region guidance.
Template detail shows step preview and region guidance.
Preparation explains what the user will practice first and keeps privacy copy clear.
Step guide shows region badge, intensity reminder, technique breakdown, and final check.
Completion shows completed region summary and next-practice guidance.
Ordinary user path hides registry/simulator/gate/production writer terms.
